scope: Bundled marketplace/service discovery photos and marketing photo cards. Originals retained; no user-uploaded files or runtime data altered.
review: Original / wide / square contact sheets inspected for all 228 source photographs. Intermediate ratios follow the same focal settings; device review remains required.

needsReplacementOrDifferentFrame.reason: Existing source shows an empty room rather than a visible cat; a crop cannot recover missing subject content.
Existing source does not show the animal in the available image; needs a better original.
The complete car is wider than a square crop; the full vehicle cannot be retained while filling this frame.
Full wingspan cannot fit a square crop without losing edges.
Full extended body and both participants cannot all fit the square crop.
Car and entire family span the full source width; square crop preserves the central interaction, not every participant.
All participants span the source width and cannot all remain in a square crop.

quality: Some existing sources are only about 315x161 pixels. Derivatives never upscale them; inspect belowTarget flags in photo-crops.json before using larger frames.
excluded: App icons, logos, text-bearing carousel artwork, arbitrary uploaded/published editor images, avatars and user listings are not destructively cropped by this offline preparation.
